summary: Encrypted messaging and channel platform with 950M+ users — privacy-first positioning and channels create strong community lock-in.
moat: Telegram's moat combines encryption trust with channel and supergroup infrastructure hosting millions of communities outside mainstream moderation. Its 950+ million user base means many communities exist only on Telegram, creating destination lock-in for members seeking access to those groups. The platform's bot API has become the backbone of automated community tools and payment flows in many emerging markets.

challengers.name: Signal and privacy-first messaging alternatives
challengers.evidence: Signal gained 40 million downloads in a single week in January 2021 after WhatsApp policy changes, demonstrating that Telegram's user base can shift rapidly when platform trust is disrupted.
